The '''Sedesians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]]. Because of Sedesia's high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], Sedesians were short, wide, and stockily built. It also gave them greater than average strength. Independently minded, Sedesians were stubborn, tough, and determined. Sedesians spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with an accent.
